evals.prompt: find recent papers on diffusion models for protein design
evals.expected_output: Runs a web search via the Exa script with --category "research paper" (optionally with an academic domain allowlist), starting with a small query. Returns real results with authors, year and DOI or URL, and does not cite anything from memory.

evals.prompt: I'm writing the related-work section for my ICLR submission on sparse autoencoders for interpreting LLM activations. Find me peer-reviewed or arXiv sources from 2024 onward, and skip blog posts and news coverage. Show which search parameters you used.
evals.expected_output: Uses exa_search.py with --category "research paper" and an include-domains allowlist (arxiv.org, openreview, etc.) in a two-pass strategy. Prefers primary research and preprints, and cites with author and year, preferring DOI links. Reports the exact command and parameters, and states any uncertainty.

evals.prompt: Here are 12 links to PDFs and journal pages from our lab's reading list. I need the full text of each pulled into one place so I can skim them for methods details.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Exa extract script (exa_extract.py) to fetch all 12 URLs in one batch call instead of one at a time. Checks that each PDF or page was actually retrieved, reports any that failed or returned partial text, and does not summarize pages it could not fetch.

evals.prompt: Compile a manuscript research packet with competing findings and verified references on gut microbiome effects on checkpoint inhibitor response for my review article draft.
evals.expected_output: Does not use exa-search. This is a full manuscript evidence-compilation task and belongs to research-lookup, which gathers literature, verifies sources and builds a research packet.

evals.prompt: Set up a recurring monitor that watches the web for new CRISPR base-editing announcements and enriches this CSV of 200 companies with funding data.
evals.expected_output: Does not use exa-search. Recurring web monitors and structured enrichment of supplied rows are parallel-web capabilities, so the agent should route there.
